title: Stage Query Bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs, let $0<\\tau\\le1$, and let $k<n$. For a finite family $A$ of coordinate subsets, put $C=\\bigcup_{S\\in A}\\{S,S\\cup\\{k\\}\\}$, and let $m$ be the sample count used by the stage with accuracy parameter $\\tau^2/4$ and confidence parameter $1/[40(n+1)(\\lceil4/\\tau^2\\rceil+1)]$. Every possible outcome of this stage uses at most $|C|\\cdot 2m$ membership queries to the target.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
$A$ is a finite family of coordinate subsets
the outcome lies in the support of the stage run with target $f$
